title: Top hat with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- hat brim -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="68" rx="42" ry="9" fill="#4a3b8c"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="66" rx="42" ry="9" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <!-- hat body -->
  <rect x="22" y="18" width="56" height="50" rx="4" fill="#6a5acd"/>
  <rect x="22" y="18" width="56" height="50" rx="4" fill="url(#hatShade)"/>
  <!-- hat band -->
  <rect x="22" y="52" width="56" height="12" fill="#ff6b9d"/>
  <rect x="22" y="52" width="56" height="3" fill="#ff9ac1"/>
  <!-- hat top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="20" rx="26" ry="4" fill="#8a7be0"/>
  <!-- hat shine -->
  <rect x="28" y="24" width="6" height="24" rx="3" fill="#9b8cf0" opacity="0.6"/>
  <!-- face on hat body -->
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="40" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2a1a5e"/>
  <ellipse cx="62" cy="40" rx="5" ry="6" fill="#2a1a5e"/>
  <circle cx="39.5" cy="38" r="2" fill="#aef0ff"/>
  <circle cx="63.5" cy="38" r="2" fill="#aef0ff"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="28" cy="48" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ff8fb8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <ellipse cx="72" cy="48" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#ff8fb8" opacity="0.7"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M36 48 Q50 60 64 48" stroke="#2a1a5e" stroke-width="3" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- little sparkles -->
  <circle cx="18" cy="30" r="2" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="34" r="2.5" fill="#ffe066"/>
  <circle cx="16" cy="46" r="1.5" fill="#aef0ff"/>
  <circle cx="85" cy="48" r="1.5" fill="#aef0ff"/>
  <defs>
    <linearGradient id="hatShade" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0" stop-color="#5a4abd" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
      <stop offset="0.5" stop-color="#6a5acd" stop-opacity="0"/>
      <stop offset="1" stop-color="#5a4abd" stop-opacity="0.5"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>
</svg>
